Describe your project

Services

What we build

Every project is made to measure. These are the building blocks we put together most often.

  • Management systems

    Stock, sales, clients, staff and reports — the day-to-day of your business in one system.

  • Desktop apps that work offline

    Windows software with a local database that keeps running when the connection drops and syncs when it's back.

  • Web & mobile apps

    Dashboards you open from any browser, and Android apps for your team on the move.

  • WhatsApp automation

    Quotes, invoices, confirmations and reminders sent to your customers automatically.

  • Documents & printing

    Contracts, invoices, prescriptions and labels in French and Arabic, on your letterhead.

  • Migration & integrations

    We bring in your existing Excel files and connect the tools you already use.

Made for Algeria

Built for the way business works here

  • French & Arabic, side by side

    Screens and printed documents in both languages, with proper right-to-left layout.

  • Local formats

    Dinars, wilayas, Algerian phone numbers and the documents your customers expect.

  • Unstable connection? No problem

    Desktop systems keep running offline and catch up automatically.

  • A team you can reach

    Support on WhatsApp, with on-site installation and training.

How we work

From the first call to a system your team uses every day

  1. 01

    Discovery

    A call or a visit to understand how you work. You receive a written scope, timeline and quote.

  2. 02

    Prototype

    You see and click through the main screens before development starts.

  4. 04

    Installation on your machines, training for your team and support after go-live.

FAQ

Questions clients usually ask

How long does a project take?

It depends on the scope. Adapting AutoDMS or ClinicOS is much faster than building from scratch. After the discovery call you get a written timeline, so you know what to expect before you commit.

Can you adapt AutoDMS or ClinicOS to my business?

Yes. They are starting points, not fixed packages: screens, documents, roles and workflows are adjusted to match the way you already work.

Does it work without internet?

The desktop versions keep working offline and sync automatically once the connection is back. Web dashboards need a connection.

Where is my data stored?

On your own computers, on a server you choose, or both. We discuss the right setup for your business during discovery.

What happens after delivery?

We install the system, train your team and stay available for questions, fixes and new features.

Do you work outside Algiers?

Yes. We work remotely with businesses across Algeria and travel for installation and training when needed.
